title: Prediction of gene expression levels in Saccharomyces cerevisiae based on chromatin accessibility using multiple machine learning models.
authors: Dong, Biyu; Hu, Bin; Jia, Peiheng; Ren, Chao; Hu, Pengzhen; He, Guohang; He, Song; Chen, Hebing; Lu, Yiming; Liang, Yating
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习基于染色质可及性预测酵母基因表达，虽涉及转录因子结合相关区域，但未聚焦TF-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移但深度不足。
abstract: Chromatin accessibility is generally associated with the binding of transcription factors and other regulatory proteins, which is fundamental to governing gene transcription. While the association between chromatin accessibility and gene expression levels is critical for transcriptional regulation, it remains incompletely characterized. Saccharomyces cerevisiae is a key eukaryotic model organism and a widely used chassis in synthetic biology, but studies on predicting gene expression from chromatin accessible regions are lacking. We developed Yeast-Gene, a supervised machine learning model that uses k-mer features from chromatin accessible regions to predict gene expression. Yeast-Gene focuses on local sequences of a few hundred base pairs within chromatin accessible regions. The model achieves an Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.90. The interpretability analysis identified AAGAA and CAAGA as highly influential motifs in the prediction of gene expression, and both motifs are potentially associated with mRNA splicing. These predictive features may contribute to the rational design of high-expression regulatory elements in synthetic biology.
abstract_zh: 染色质可及性通常与转录因子及其他调控蛋白的结合相关，这对于调控基因转录至关重要。尽管染色质可及性与基因表达水平之间的关联对转录调控至关重要，但其特征尚未被完全阐明。酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）是一种关键的真核模式生物，也是合成生物学中广泛使用的底盘生物，但基于染色质可及区域预测基因表达的研究尚属空白。我们开发了Yeast-Gene，一种监督式机器学习模型，利用染色质可及区域中的k-mer特征来预测基因表达。Yeast-Gene聚焦于染色质可及区域内数百碱基对的局部序列。该模型实现了0.90的曲线下面积（Area Under the Curve, AUC）。可解释性分析识别出AAGAA和CAAGA为基因表达预测中高度影响的基序，且这两个基序可能与mRNA剪接相关。这些预测特征可能有助于合成生物学中高表达调控元件的理性设计。
